purpose: Sensitivity inputs only. These crew man-hours are analyst-selected scenario knobs, not VIUS, BLS, Bellhop, FMCSA, or national moving-industry estimates.
unit: total crew man-hours per move (sum of each mover's paid handling hours; not elapsed clock hours)
allocation_assumption: 50% of total crew man-hours at origin and 50% at destination, solely to expose local wage sensitivity. No crew count or elapsed duration is inferred.
limitations: Scenario values are not observed or validated productivity data.
They are not a statistical interval or confidence interval.
They do not include packing, stairs, long carries, waiting, access constraints, special handling, or seasonality.
Replace only after obtaining mover-specific anonymized job records or defensible time-and-motion observations.
